I will teach *Discrete Mathematics* to BS Information Technology students at
Bulacan State University's
[Bustos Campus](https://bulsu.edu.ph/academics/campus/Bustos){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
in the Second Semester of A.Y. 2026–2027.

Discrete mathematics studies finite and countable structures and develops
reasoning used throughout computing. It provides a foundation for working with
logic, algorithms, data structures, and networks.

## Course materials

Lecture notes, exercises, and supplementary materials will be added here as
they are prepared.
